[NDBG.16.1] The table below maps DS concepts to the standard DAP
surface used, and identifies where custom extensions fill gaps.

| DS concept | DAP surface | Custom extension |
|---|---|---|
| Session lifecycle | `initialize`, `launch`, `configurationDone` ([NDBG.9.3.7]), `restart`, `disconnect` | `ds/loadRecording` for replay; launch arguments in [NDBG.9.3.1] |
| Execution control | `continue`, `next`, `stepIn`, `stepOut`, `stepInTargets`, `pause` ([NDBG.11.1.4]) | `ds/stepGranularity` ([NDBG.14.1]); `ds/advanceClock` ([NDBG.14.18]) |
| Reverse execution | `stepBack`, `reverseContinue` | — |
| Jump to a firing | `gotoTargets`, `goto` ([NDBG.14r.5]) | — |
| Rule-fire breakpoints | `setFunctionBreakpoints` | — |
| Source-line breakpoints | `setBreakpoints` (`rule`, `after` and `on response` lines) | — |
| Exception breakpoints | `setExceptionBreakpoints` ([NDBG.12.6]) | — |
| Fact-event breakpoints | — | `ds/setFactBreakpoints` ([NDBG.12.3]) |
| Cache-op breakpoints | — | `ds/setCacheBreakpoints` ([NDBG.12.5]) |
| Firings | `threads`, `stackTrace` ([NDBG.10.1]) | — (`RuleDebugName` for display names) |
| Bound variables | `scopes`, `variables` (Bindings scope) | — |
| Working memory (all) | `scopes`, `variables` (WM scope) | `ds/getWorkingMemory` with `where` filter ([NDBG.14w]) |
| Cache and calls | `scopes`, `variables` (Cache and Calls scopes, [NDBG.13.1.1]) | — |
| Logical justifiers | `variables` (`_justifiers` child) | `ds/getJustifiers` ([NDBG.14.3]) |
| Json slot drilling | `variables` (recursive, [NDBG.13.5]) | — |
| Watches, hovers and the debug console | `evaluate` ([NDBG.13.7]) | — |
| The program's `log` lines | `output` events, category `"stdout"` ([NDBG.9.3.6]) | — |
| WM delta between positions | — | `ds/diffWorkingMemory` ([NDBG.20]) |
| Fact lineage | — | `ds/getFactLineage` ([NDBG.14.4]) |
| Firing match path | — | `ds/getActivationPath` ([NDBG.14.11]) |
| Refracted activations | — | `ds/getRefractedActivations` ([NDBG.14.12]) |
| Fact injection | — | `ds/assertFact`, `ds/retractFact` ([NDBG.14.13], [NDBG.14.14]) |
| Call answers | — | `ds/answerCall` ([NDBG.14.19]); `ds/installMock`, `ds/removeMock` ([NDBG.14.15], [NDBG.14.16]) |
| Hypothesis forks | — | `ds/timelines`, `ds/switchTimeline`, `ds/dropTimeline` ([NDBG.14.17]) |
| Rete topology | — | `ds/getReteNetwork` ([NDBG.14.6]) |
| Match trace | — | `ds/getMatchTrace` ([NDBG.14.7]) |
| Timer agenda | — | `ds/getTimerAgenda` ([NDBG.14.8]) |
| Event trace events | `output` events | `ds/factAsserted`, `ds/factRetracted`, `ds/logicalFactFlipped`, `ds/callMade`, `ds/callAnswered` ([NDBG.15]); chosen by `ds/streamEvents` ([NDBG.14.20]) |
